title: Pocketwire Personal Account Funding, Top-Up and Direct Deposit Schedule
content:
The funding-side figures of the Pocketwire Personal Account, set per plan:

| Plan | Credit card funding of P2P payments | Credit card funding fee (percent of the payment) | Instant top-up fee from a linked debit card (percent of the top-up) | Daily top-up limit (USD, per Eastern Time calendar day) | Early direct deposit (calendar days before the payer's scheduled pay date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Lite | Not available | 3.00 | 1.50 | 500.00 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Core | Available | 3.00 | 1.50 | 2500.00 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Plus | Available | 3.00 | 1.25 | 5000.00 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Prime | Available | 2.75 | 1.00 | 7500.00 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | Available | 2.50 | 0.75 | 10000.00 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Summit | Available | 2.00 | 0.50 | 25000.00 | 2 |

### What the columns mean

- **Credit card funding** — whether P2P payments may be funded from a linked credit card on the plan.
- **Credit card funding fee** — the fee on a P2P payment funded by a linked credit card, as a percentage of the payment amount.
- **Instant top-up fee** — the fee on an instant add-money from a linked debit card, as a percentage of the top-up amount.
- **Daily top-up limit** — the cap on the sum of add-money top-ups initiated on one calendar day, Eastern Time.
- **Early direct deposit** — how many calendar days before the payer's scheduled pay date a direct deposit is made available.

### Notes

- Pocketwire Lite lists a credit card funding fee rate of 3.00 percent although credit card funding is not available on it.
- Pocketwire Lite makes direct deposits available 0 days early; every other plan up to 2 days early.
